scope.objective: Separate hostile guidance that retrieval never selects from hostile guidance retrieved then filtered, using one additive fail-closed four-stage metric and real-surface reporting without changing any scenario, retrieval, incident-agent behavior, or authority boundary.
forbidden_work: change any scenario, expected result, terminal state, document, retriever, ranking, decision context, agent, model, prompt, or output schema
replace or reinterpret the released three-stage exposure metric; the successor must be additive
count guidance never retrieved as post-retrieval filtering success
silently accept mixed trial stages, malformed retrieval identities, or ambiguous catalog stages
add or change an action, capability, policy, approval, authentication, executor, API authority, or MCP authority
add a dependency, paid service, secret, model asset, externally controlled asset, or real-infrastructure connector
weaken any source, package, container, security, clean-clone, review, or public-release gate
claim the new metric improves retrieval behavior or proves production readiness or universal prompt-injection resistance
reversible_actions: create and update project-authored files on codex/baseline-0028-retrieval-stage-observability
run deterministic source package container dashboard and clean-clone verification under C:/Projects
version commit push review merge and release the exact verified source plus zipapp checkpoint after all gates pass

the metric cannot be computed from already-retained exact retrieval identities without changing runtime behavior
any scenario, terminal state, retriever, decision context, action, authority, dependency, secret, paid service, external asset, or real infrastructure would need to change

The first container-runtime-v8 draft accidentally introduced historical WORKDIR content and reused current Dockerfile constants while checking v7. The validator failed closed before any archive or image build; the corrected exact-inheritance result and failure receipt are retained.

Final source attempt 001 used evidence-only-context-v2 instead of the sealed fresh-content-stale-metadata-context-v3 and correctly returned remediate on four stale-payload gates; attempt 002 corrected only the invocation and passed.

The first source API/dashboard verifier run passed 116 of 117 checks and rendered BASELINE 0028, but its manifest-bound verifier still required Baseline 0027. The original public receipt's count-only 109/110 statement is retained and superseded by a static recount; the stale verifier failure and old-manifest package remain retained.
